items.title: Augmentor meaning owner unresolved
items.description: The product meaning owner for cross-plane ontology review has not been selected.

items.title: Disposable index owner unresolved
items.description: No owner is selected for GraphDelta compilation, the disposable semantic index, or bounded projections.

items.title: Routing and approval integration absent
items.description: The public resolver and host adapter have candidate evidence outside ResonantOS, but Interaction, snapshot, product request normalization, route-catalog projection, RouteDecision, disposition presentation, strategy projection, and exact approval registration are not observed as one enabled product flow.

items.title: Orchestrate-to-Resonant binding absent
items.description: No production binding maps approved Orchestrate actions and addressed revisions to exact ResonantOS host operations.

items.title: Trusted durable memory path incomplete
items.description: Observed memory and archive owners do not establish the joined provider review, correction, forgetting, and ontology handoff path.

items.title: Reasoning integration remains non-authorizing
items.description: A bounded evaluator witness exists in CAV2. The deterministic intent-route resolver and adapter do not replace it, and no admitted Augmentor reasoning request adapter, reasoning applicability/catalog owner, or independent exact-effect integration exists.

items.title: Authority resolver and canonical writer absent
items.description: The package cannot select an authority-kind owner, decide a candidate, register a transition, or write a canonical artifact.
